metadata.title: What if Tanjiro could hear demons' thoughts?
metadata.description:
Tanjiro gains hypothetical access to demon thoughts and learns that empathy is useful but thoughts do not guarantee honesty or harmlessness.

Original hypothetical comedy and commentary. Fan-made alternate scenario; events and dialogue are invented, not canon. AI-assisted narration: Kokoro am_michael. Sound effects: Brackeys, public domain.

#Shorts #Anime #WhatIf #DemonSlayer
